theme_and_identity.rationale: An occupational health & safety (İSG) risk analysis tool for a major restaurant chain needs absolute clarity. The UI must strip away decorative elements so the safety data and risk scores remain the sole focus.

rules: Avoid 'Inter' for headings. Use Chivo for a structured corporate feel.
Use tabular-nums for all risk scores and severity metrics so digits align perfectly in columns.
Labels should be uppercase, tracking-[0.05em], text-xs.

colors.strategy: Function over decoration. 95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color is exclusively used to indicate risk levels and primary actions.

rules: Use 'calm density' with 5-7 primary metrics on the dashboard overview.
Forms: Use compact row heights with sticky headers for the 84 questions.
Spacing scale: Use p-4 to p-6 for containers. Inner elements use tight spacing (gap-2, gap-4) to maximize data visibility.
Never use full-screen gradients. Use flat, solid backgrounds.

components.navigation: Fixed sidebar or sticky top nav with high-contrast text. Must include clear 'New Audit' CTA.

audit_form.structure: Horizontal tabs or vertical accordion for the 9 categories. Avoid endless scrolling without structure.
audit_form.questions: Each row should be a clearly demarcated line (border-b) with zebra striping (bg-zinc-50/50) for scannability.
audit_form.conditional_logic: When 'Hayır' is selected, expand a detailed sub-panel immediately below the question for: Olasılık (Select), Şiddet (Select), Risk Skoru (Auto-calc), Risk Seviyesi (Badge), Termin (Datepicker), and Tedbir (Textarea).

components.dashboards: KPI cards at the top (Total Audits, Unacceptable Risks, Pending Actions). Use Recharts for risk distribution.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-md max), fully opaque brand color for primary, outline for secondary.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the grid skeleton. Use 1px border-border/40 for structural separation.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: NO GLASSMORPHISM. Use solid, opaque backgrounds for medical/clinical/audit clarity.
visual_enhancers.feedback: Use Sonner for toast notifications on save/export.

rules: Use smooth accordion expansion for category toggles and 'Hayır' sub-panels (framer-motion AnimatePresence).
Hover states must be a lighter hue of the active state.
Strict APCA/WCAG contrast compliance, especially for Red/Amber/Green text on colored backgrounds.
Focus states must have a 2px solid ring (ring-zinc-900).
Add aria-expanded for conditional risk panels.

login_bg.description: Professional chef in kitchen - use as a dark overlay background for the login/registration screen to ground the app in the restaurant context.

empty_state.description: Man working at desk - use for 'No audits found' empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using standard React JS (.js/.jsx files), Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI components.
Implement a robust routing system (e.g., React Router) for Login, Dashboard, and Audit Form views.
For the 84 questions, construct a JSON configuration mapping questions to their 9 categories to render them dynamically.
Risk Score Logic: Score = Olasılık * Şiddet. Map the numerical score to 'Kabul Edilemez', 'Dikkate Değer', or 'Kabul Edilebilir' based on standard İSG matrices, and color the UI accordingly.
Add 'data-testid' to EVERY interactive element (buttons, inputs, tabs, export actions) for testing compatibility.
Install and use 'lucide-react' for all iconography. Avoid generic emojis.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications on success/error states.
Implement Excel/PDF export logic using libraries like xlsx and jspdf/html2canvas, or mock the functionality cleanly if libraries are not installed.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (* { transition: all }). Only apply transitions to specific interactive elements.
DO NOT center align the app container in index.css.
universal_guidelines: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep audit data flat and legible.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Subtle grain textures or noise overlays can be used on the login page, but keep the dashboard pristine.
